title: Atmospheric Particulate Tracing
keywords_for_the_page_and_card: Air quality · Isotope tracing · Aerosol deposition · Environmental sensors
intro: We follow airborne particles from the moment they leave a source to the place where they finally settle — in lakes, on soil and in the air we breathe.

add_image.image_alt: Continuous particulate sampling station at the urban baseline site

add_focus_list: Continuous PM2.5 / PM10 sampling with compositional fingerprinting
Wet and dry deposition into lakes and reservoirs
Low-cost sensor networks paired with dispersion modelling
add_paragraph:
Atmospheric particulates carry metals, organics and microplastics across regions and deposit them into freshwater systems. We run continuous sampling stations that fingerprint plumes by size, composition and isotopic signature, then model where those particles travel and settle.

The goal is a clear line of evidence from emission source to environmental impact — turning episodic haze events into quantified inputs for catchment and health models.
